verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments and financial platform, since some payment platforms ship self-hostable deployments, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only Airwallex-hosted services and SDKs, with nothing showing the core product can be deployed on user infrastructure. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
